claim: Try four sample notes in a separate demo that can be reset without changing real data.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser storage; seed real-looking keys; enter from the landing action; route, reset, and leave the demo

claim: The router shows one untriaged note and advances after one route.
sandbox: fresh demo; route the visible sample; assert one different current note and updated counts

claim: Recall, solve, teach, do, and archive each create exactly one actionable ticket.
sandbox: reset the demo before each route; assert one new ticket, route metadata, and completion field

claim: The extension writes a separate ticket under .rehearsal and does not change the source note.
sandbox: shipped sample note in a disposable in-memory directory; compare source bytes and created ticket

claim: The extension waits for the user and does not choose or summarize an action.
sandbox: fresh demo; wait without input and compare state and displayed source excerpt

claim: The extension scans the chosen folder and has no permission to read web pages.
sandbox: scan one disposable chosen directory and inspect the packaged MV3 permission boundary

claim: A later scan adds new Markdown files to the queue.
sandbox: add a second file to the disposable sample directory between two production scans

claim: The free tier routes 30 notes.
sandbox: 31 derived sample notes; assert 30 available before routing and the 31st held after 30 tickets

claim: Undo restores the last routed note and removes its ledger entry.
sandbox: fresh demo; route one note, undo, and compare note title and ticket counts

claim: Ledger export stays available in the free tier.
sandbox: fresh demo; route once, download Markdown, and count exported ticket headings

claim: A US $19 one-time license enables unlimited routing and custom ticket folders.
sandbox: fresh demo plus packaged extension; fixture valid verification; save a custom folder and test the 31st note

claim: License verification sends only the token and reuses a result for one day.
sandbox: packaged extension with a recorded valid response; inspect the request and reload within the cache window

claim: A revoked or refunded license disables paid settings.
sandbox: packaged extension with a recorded revoked response; assert the notice and locked custom-folder field

claim: Sociobot / Dodo handles checkout, and the product does not collect card details.
sandbox: fresh product page; inspect the checkout destination, payment inputs, frames, and loaded resource origins

claim: The sample and free workflow do not upload notes or run analytics, advertising, or trackers.
sandbox: record every request through route, undo, and reset; allow only the product origin

claim: Forget local data clears browser-held state without deleting ticket files.
sandbox: packaged extension with browser state and an OPFS ticket; reset and inspect both stores

claim: The extension keeps its folder handle, ledger, preferences, and license in browser storage.
sandbox: fresh packaged extension; store a handle and ledger in its browser origin, then read both before reset

claim: The packaged free desk opens without a hosted service.
sandbox: fresh packaged extension context; go offline and reload the onboarding desk

claim: Number keys 1–5 route the current note.
sandbox: fresh demo; press 2 and assert a solve ticket, queue advance, and retained focus

claim: The demo ledger remains in its separate browser storage namespace across reloads.
sandbox: fresh demo; route, reload, and compare the demo-prefixed state
